notes.title: Second Update Available Now!
notes.notes:
We promised you updates, we promised you new cars … and so the time has finally come for us to announce that the second update is available to play [b]now[/b]! 

It wouldn’t be an Inertial Drift update if it didn’t include a new car, right? Get ready for the [b]HP Katana  XT![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36398504/0c87a5c7811ca4e02ce71ae2c059bc78f2de80fb.gif[/img]

What are you waiting for? Get playing with the latest free update,[b] it’s only a month until the next one[/b]! And you know what that means … exactly, more new cars are coming your way very soon. 

Check out the trailer for the[b] Second Inertial Drift Update[/b] here: 

[previewyoutube=j1dWY76M3F8;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Steam Patch Notes - 23.09.20
notes.notes:
Hello Drifters, 

We've been overwhelmed by your enthusiasm and support for Inertial Drift over the past couple of weeks. Thanks to everyone who has provided thoughts, feedback and ideas as to how we can improve the game. We will assess all of these and will look to make improvements to the game in subsequent updates. 

For the time being, a smaller update is now live on Steam: 
[list]
[*] Adjusted the difficulty of the events in several [b]Challenges[/b] and [b]Grand Prix Mode[/b]. Including those for Dragon, Chrono, 7D, Jet Z, Bullet, Jester, Gecko RX and Gladio. 
[*] Added the ability to Finish Event early from the pause menu in Endurance events after a medal has been achieved.
[/list]

Remember that you can join our new [url=https://discord.gg/AxXHwgJ][b]Discord Server[/b][/url] to join the discussion about the game! 

Happy Drifting! 

- PQube & Level 91 Entertainment

notes.title: Developer Update - Restarts are in!
notes.notes:
Due to popular demand the very-sensible option of mid-race restarts has now been added to Inertial Drift and the current free demo [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1302110/Inertial_Drift_Sunset_Prologue/]Inertial Drift: Sunset Prologue.[/url]

[previewyoutube=RudxXu4ujpk;full][/previewyoutube]

Hopefully this will make quitting in and out to try for those times a bit more efficient! 
As ever, any further feedback, please let us know and we'll see what we can do!

If you've yet to try out Sunset Prologue, you can [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1302110/Inertial_Drift_Sunset_Prologue/]check it out here.[/url]
Best,
The Level 91 and PQube teams.

notes.title: Development Update - New features to help you learn from your opponents
notes.notes:
[h3]In Inertial Drift, you'll need to learn from your competitors as well as compete with them! Studying the lines that others are using could give you an edge in those intense 1v1 races, and the team have recently introduced two new upgrades to help you do just that![/h3]


[i][b]Break Trails That Hang in the Air [/b]
[previewyoutube=csaVrki3YIw;full][/previewyoutube]

If you're already familiar with Inertial Drift, you'll know that the break trails from your car and your opponent's car hang in the air for a short while. Notice your opponent acing a tricky corner? Study their break trails to see exactly where they applied and released the breaks!

A new proximity based fade sees the trails fade-out as you cover the same ground, allowing you to replicate your opponent's throttle & break timings in real-time. 


[b]Glowing Skid Trails [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36398504/ad6963148dcb435ab4c7c4f25ac5e7895cddf009.png[/img]

Another recent addition comes in the form of glowing skid trails. Racing ghosts - whether your own or somebody else's - is another invaluable opportunity to hone your craft. These new glowing skid-trails for ghosts make it even easier to study their lines. 


Remember, each car in Inertial Drift is different! Simply copying what your opponent does is no guaruntee of success...


Thanks and stay tuned for more!
- PQube & Level 91 Entertainment[/i]

notes.title: Development Update - Brand New Backdrops!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=2DqOatkbGV0;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]Inertial Drift's single player Story Mode is the perfect way for rookie racers to learn their trade. You'll join a group of friends on a road trip that will take in several challenging circuits, with plenty of opportunity to get behind the wheel, refine your driving style and - of course - race! 

We think the new track-specific backdrops to the menu and narrative sections of the game help bring each track-side location to life! 

- PQube & Inertial Drift[/i]
